# Reveal.js 4.6.1

The deck retains its existing Reveal.js version. These files are bundled locally
so presenting does not depend on a CDN connection:

- reveal.js — reveal.js@4.6.1/dist/reveal.js
- reveal.css — reveal.js@4.6.1/dist/reveal.css
- notes.js — reveal.js@4.6.1/plugin/notes/notes.js

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/reveal.js@4.6.1/
